summary: First release: 24 vectors from 8 Louisiana schedules (November 2026 billing month) at 250, 1,000, and 5,000 kWh, exercising fixed charges, flat energy rates, and riders; 8 schedules could not be written yet, each listed with why.
The untestable list gains Kansas's three utilities, whose commission publishes one consumption level and no rates, so their charges cannot be written as a tariff. The 24 vectors are unchanged.
